description: A tuple unified with a shorter tuple gives a list
notes: The spec unifies tuple types only when they have the same length, and a tuple can't convert to a tuple of another length, so this should fail. hashicorp/hcl unifies tuples of different lengths to a list of their unified element types (unifyTupleTypes and unifyTupleTypesToList in cty/convert/unify.go), also when the longer tuple comes first (native/types/unify-tuples-of-different-lengths-gives-list has the shorter one first).
